accessibility.title: Structural Analysis module introduction static overview
accessibility.long_description: A text-first overview of Structural Analysis. Model trusses, frames, machines, and cables; select joint or section equilibrium; identify zero-force members; classify member force sense; and preserve action-reaction and support behavior.

objective: Model trusses, frames, machines, and cables; select joint or section equilibrium; identify zero-force members; classify member force sense; and preserve action-reaction and support behavior.
prerequisites: Bring rigid-body free-body diagrams, support reactions, two-force-member behavior, planar equilibrium, and consistent tension/compression sign conventions.

worked_example.entry_description: Inspect a pin-connected structure, test the simple-truss assumptions and determinacy counts, then choose a joint or section entry point without collapsing the canonical topic to the TRUSSES runtime alias.

diagram_description: The planned structural systems, trusses, frames, and cables will support: drag joint geometry; toggle pin roller and fixed supports; apply joint loads; highlight two-force and zero-force members; select a joint free-body diagram; place a section cut through members; toggle tension and compression assumptions; show pin action-reaction pairs; rotate a space-truss view; adjust cable geometry. Until v1.1.0 is published, this description and procedure map are the complete accessible fallback.
